# `reason`

A reason a mod gives for a refusal of its own: a sentence and the values it carries (14 §15).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `text` ([text](../values.md#texts); **required**): The sentence, as a text template.
- `values` (object, name → string; optional): The values the reason carries, by name, each with its type as the language writes types (`entity`, `real`, `id<channel>`). Default none.
- `doc` (string; optional): When the reason is given.
